  <!-- AVVIO: se sul telefono c'è un aggiornamento già scaricato (più nuovo dell'APK),
       sostituisce questa pagina con quella aggiornata. Se l'avvio dell'aggiornamento
       non arriva in fondo per 2 volte di fila lo scarta e torna alla versione dell'APK.
       1.0.42 lo scrive GitHub Actions a ogni build. -->
  <script>
  (function () {
    var APK_VERSION = "1.0.42";
    function parts(v) { return String(v || '').replace(/^v/i, '').split('.').map(function (n) { return parseInt(n, 10) || 0; }); }
    function newer(a, b) {
      var x = parts(a), y = parts(b);
      for (var i = 0; i < Math.max(x.length, y.length); i++) {
        if ((x[i] || 0) > (y[i] || 0)) return true;
        if ((x[i] || 0) < (y[i] || 0)) return false;
      }
      return false;
    }
    if (window.__MZ_BOOT || APK_VERSION.indexOf('__') === 0) return;
    try {
      var raw = localStorage.getItem('mz_bundle');
      if (!raw) return;
      var b = JSON.parse(raw);
      if (!b || !b.html || !newer(b.version, APK_VERSION)) { localStorage.removeItem('mz_bundle'); localStorage.removeItem('mz_try'); return; }
      var tries = parseInt(localStorage.getItem('mz_try') || '0', 10);
      if (tries >= 2) {
        localStorage.removeItem('mz_bundle'); localStorage.removeItem('mz_try');
        localStorage.setItem('mz_bad', b.version);
        return;
      }
      localStorage.setItem('mz_try', String(tries + 1));
      window.__MZ_BOOT = b.version;
      /* document.open() durante il caricamento viene ignorato dal browser:
         la sostituzione avviene appena la pagina è stata letta. */
      document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', function () {
        document.open(); document.write(b.html); document.close();
      });
    } catch (e) {}
  })();
  </script>

@import url('https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Roboto+Mono:wght@400;500;700&family=Roboto:wght@300;400;500;700;900&display=swap');

* {
  box-sizing: border-box;
}

html, body {
  height: 100vh;
  width: 100vw;
  margin: 0;
  padding: 0;
  overflow: hidden;
  font-family: 'Roboto', sans-serif;
  background-color: #0b0f19;
  display: flex;
  justify-content: center;
  align-items: center;
}

/* TELAIO FLUIDO E ADATTIVO PER QUALSIASI RISOLUZIONE */
.terminal-frame {
  width: 100vw;
  height: 100vh;
  background: #1e293b;
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  position: relative;
  overflow: hidden;
}

/* BOTTONI A PILLOLA */
.btn-pill {
  border-radius: clamp(10px, 1.5vw, 18px);
  transition: all 0.12s ease;
  font-weight: 700;
}
.btn-pill:active {
  transform: scale(0.98);
}

/* DIMENSIONAMENTO DINAMICO DEI TESTI ED ICONE */
.responsive-title { font-size: clamp(1rem, 2.2vw, 2rem); }
.responsive-subtitle { font-size: clamp(0.7rem, 1.2vw, 1.1rem); }
.responsive-label { font-size: clamp(0.65rem, 1vw, 0.9rem); }
.responsive-input { font-size: clamp(0.75rem, 1.2vw, 1.1rem); padding-top: clamp(0.3rem, 1vh, 0.75rem); padding-bottom: clamp(0.3rem, 1vh, 0.75rem); }
.responsive-icon { font-size: clamp(1.8rem, 3.5vw, 3.5rem); }

</style>

/* CREAZIONE UDC: etichette, campi e pulsanti-icona dimensionati sull'altezza dello schermo */
.cu-label { font-size: clamp(0.9rem, 2vw, 1.8rem); font-weight: 500; line-height: 1.1; }
.cu-input {
  height: clamp(2.6rem, 9vh, 4.4rem);
  font-size: clamp(1rem, 2vw, 1.8rem);
  font-weight: 600;
  letter-spacing: 0.03em;
}
.cu-icon {
  width: clamp(2.6rem, 9vh, 4rem);
  height: clamp(2.6rem, 9vh, 4rem);
  display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center;
  border-radius: 12px;
  font-size: clamp(1.2rem, 3.4vh, 2rem);
  flex-shrink: 0;
}
/* campo non valido dopo CONFERMA (sovrascrive il bordo del tema) */
.cu-error { border-color: #ef4444 !important; background-color: rgba(239, 68, 68, 0.08) !important; }

/* ---- TASTIERINO NUMERICO GRANDE (solo in Creazione UDC) ----
   Occupa tutta l'altezza del riquadro a destra, con tasti grandi.

#screen-creazione-udc #numpad:not(.hidden) {

  flex-direction: column;
  gap: 1.2vh;
  top: 1.5vh;

  border-radius: 1.2rem;
}
#screen-creazione-udc #numpad .kp-row {

  min-height: 0;
  width: 100%;

  margin: 0 !important;      /* i margini inline messi da numpad.js */

#screen-creazione-udc #numpad .vkey {

  border-radius: 10px;
}
#screen-creazione-udc #numpad .vkey i { font-size: clamp(1.2rem, 4.2vh, 2.6rem); }

/* CREAZIONE UDC DA DDT: righe dell'elenco ordini e barra di ricerca */

/* elenco: scorre solo lui; niente "rimbalzo" che trascini la barra in alto */
.ud-list {
  overscroll-behavior: contain;
  -webkit-overflow-scrolling: touch;
  scrollbar-width: none;
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
}
.ud-list::-webkit-scrollbar { display: none; }

/* riga ordine standard */
.ud-card {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: 19% 31% 19% 1fr auto;
  align-items: center;
  column-gap: 0.5vw;
  row-gap: 0.4vh;
  padding: 1.6vh 2vw 1.6vh 2vw;
  text-align: left;
  transition: background-color 0.3s ease;
}

/* Stile per la bolla chiusa in attesa dell'ufficio (sfondo arancione, in fondo) */
.ud-card.attesa-ufficio {
  background-color: #f97316 !important; /* Arancione */
  color: #ffffff !important;
  order: 9999 !important; /* Mette la bolla in fondo alla lista */
  border-color: #c2410c !important;
}

.ud-card.attesa-ufficio .ud-lbl {
  color: #ffedd5 !important; /* Testo etichetta chiaro per leggibilità su arancione */
}

.ud-card.attesa-ufficio .ud-val {
  color: #ffffff !important;
}

.ud-lbl {
  color: #0b8fd8;
  font-size: clamp(0.9rem, 2.2vw, 2rem);
  font-weight: 400;
  line-height: 1.15;
}
.ud-val {
  font-size: clamp(0.95rem, 2.2vw, 2rem);
  font-weight: 800;
  line-height: 1.15;
  letter-spacing: 0.01em;
  min-width: 0;
  overflow-wrap: anywhere;
}
.ud-forn { grid-column: 2 / 5; }
.ud-chev {
  grid-column: 5;
  grid-row: 1 / 3;
  font-size: clamp(0.8rem, 1.3vw, 1.2rem);
}
body.theme-dark .ud-lbl { color: #38bdf8; }

/* lente: piena quando la ricerca è aperta */
.ud-search-btn.ud-search-active { background: #16a34a; color: #fff; }

/* campo di ricerca */
.ud-search-input {
  height: clamp(2.6rem, 8vh, 4rem);
  font-size: clamp(1rem, 2vw, 1.8rem);
  font-weight: 600;
  letter-spacing: 0.03em;
}
.ud-search-clear {
  width: clamp(2.6rem, 8vh, 4rem);
  height: clamp(2.6rem, 8vh, 4rem);
  font-size: clamp(1.1rem, 3vh, 1.8rem);
  flex-shrink: 0;
}

  <style>
/* CARICO DDT: schermata di carico di un ordine (si apre dalla lista di Creazione UDC da DDT).
   Il layout usa classi proprie (cd-*) così non dipende da Tailwind. */

#screen-carico-ddt .hidden { display: none !important; }

.cd-screen:not(.hidden) {
  display: flex; flex-direction: column;
  flex: 1 1 0; min-height: 0; overflow: hidden;
}

/* ---------- barra superiore (sempre ferma) ---------- */
.cd-header {
  flex-shrink: 0;
  display: grid; grid-template-columns: auto minmax(0, 1fr) auto;
  align-items: center; gap: 1vw;
  padding: 1.2vw; margin-bottom: 1.5vh;
  border-bottom-width: 2px; border-radius: 1rem;
}
.cd-hgroup { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 1vw; }
.cd-sq {
  position: relative; flex-shrink: 0;
  width: clamp(2.5rem, 4vw, 3.8rem); height: clamp(2.5rem, 4vw, 3.8rem);
  display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center;
  border-width: 2px; border-style: solid; border-radius: 1rem;
  background: transparent; font-size: clamp(1.1rem, 2vw, 1.8rem); font-weight: 700;
  transition: all .12s ease;
}
.cd-sq.blue  { border-color: #3b82f6; color: #3b82f6; }
.cd-sq.blue:hover  { background: #3b82f6; color: #fff; }
.cd-sq.amber { border-color: #d97706; color: #d97706; }
.cd-sq.amber:hover, .cd-sq.amber.on { background: #d97706; color: #fff; }
.cd-sq.green { border-color: #16a34a; color: #16a34a; }
.cd-sq.green:hover { background: #16a34a; color: #fff; }
.cd-sq.red   { border-color: #ef4444; color: #dc2626; background: rgba(239, 68, 68, .1); }
.cd-sq.red:hover { background: #ef4444; color: #fff; }
.cd-sq:active { transform: scale(.96); }
.cd-badge {
  position: absolute; top: -.45rem; right: -.45rem;
  min-width: 1.35rem; height: 1.35rem; padding: 0 .3rem;
  border-radius: 999px; background: #d97706; color: #fff;
  font-size: .75rem; font-weight: 800; line-height: 1.35rem; text-align: center;
}
.cd-info { justify-self: center; display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 1.2vw; min-width: 0; max-width: 100%; }
.cd-info > i { flex-shrink: 0; font-size: clamp(1.8rem, 3.5vw, 3.5rem); color: #10b981; }
.cd-data {
  display: grid; grid-template-columns: auto auto auto auto;
  column-gap: 1.1vw; row-gap: .2vh; align-items: baseline; min-width: 0;
}
.cd-hlbl { color: #0b8fd8; font-size: clamp(.75rem, 1.45vw, 1.35rem); white-space: nowrap; }
.cd-hval { font-weight: 800; font-size: clamp(.8rem, 1.55vw, 1.45rem); white-space: nowrap; }
.cd-hval.forn { grid-column: 2 / 5; overflow: hidden; text-overflow: ellipsis; }
body.theme-dark .cd-hlbl { color: #38bdf8; }

/* ---------- riquadro principale ---------- */
.cd-card {
  position: relative; flex: 1 1 0; min-height: 0;
  display: flex; gap: 2vw; padding: 1.5vw;
  border-width: 1px; border-radius: 1rem;
}
.cd-left { width: 62%; display: flex; flex-direction: column; justify-content: space-around; gap: 1vh; }
.cd-right { flex: 1; min-width: 0; display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: .8vh; }

.cd-row { display: flex; align-items: center; }
.cd-row .cu-label { width: 34%; text-align: right; padding-right: 1.2vw; }
.cd-row .cu-input { flex: 1; min-width: 0; padding: 0 1rem; border-width: 2px; border-style: solid; border-radius: .75rem; cursor: pointer; }
.cd-slot { margin-left: 1vw; width: clamp(2.6rem, 9vh, 4rem); flex-shrink: 0; }
.cu-input.cd-locked { opacity: .55; cursor: not-allowed; }
.cd-lock { background: #64748b; color: #fff; }

.cd-editbar {
  display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: space-between; gap: 1vw;
  padding: .7vh 1vw; border: 2px solid #f59e0b; border-radius: .75rem;
  background: rgba(245, 158, 11, .14); font-weight: 800; font-size: clamp(.8rem, 1.5vw, 1.3rem);
}
.cd-editbar button { padding: .4vh 1.2vw; border-radius: .6rem; border: 2px solid #f59e0b; color: #b45309; font-weight: 800; font-size: clamp(.75rem, 1.3vw, 1.15rem); }
body.theme-dark .cd-editbar button { color: #fbbf24; }

/* ---------- tabella articoli nel DDT ---------- */
.cd-thead, .cd-trow { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 52% 26% 22%; }
.cd-thead { flex-shrink: 0; padding: 0 .4vw; font-size: clamp(.7rem, 1.2vw, 1.1rem); font-weight: 600; text-transform: uppercase; }
.cd-thead span { padding: 0 .6vw; }
.cd-thead span:nth-child(2), .cd-trow span:nth-child(2) { text-align: center; }
.cd-thead span:nth-child(3), .cd-trow span:nth-child(3) { text-align: right; }
.cd-table {
  --line: #cbd5e1;
  flex: 1 1 0; min-height: 0; overflow-y: auto; overscroll-behavior: contain;
  border-width: 2px; border-style: solid; border-radius: .75rem;
  background-image: linear-gradient(var(--line), var(--line)), linear-gradient(var(--line), var(--line));
  background-size: 2px 100%, 2px 100%;
  background-position: 52% 0, 78% 0;
  background-repeat: no-repeat;
}
body.theme-dark .cd-table { --line: #334155; }
.cd-trow {
  width: 100%; text-align: left; padding: 1.3vh .4vw;
  background: transparent; border: 0; font-size: clamp(.85rem, 1.5vw, 1.4rem);
}
.cd-trow span { padding: 0 .6vw; min-width: 0; overflow-wrap: anywhere; }
.cd-trow span:nth-child(2) { text-transform: uppercase; }
.cd-trow.sel  { background: rgba(59, 130, 246, .18); }
.cd-trow.done { color: #16a34a; }
.cd-trow:active { background: rgba(59, 130, 246, .28); }

.cd-confirm {
  align-self: flex-end; flex-shrink: 0;
  background: #22c55e; color: #fff; font-weight: 800; letter-spacing: .02em;
  padding: 1.4vh 3vw; border-radius: .75rem; box-shadow: 0 1px 3px rgba(0,0,0,.25);
  font-size: clamp(1rem, 2.2vw, 2rem); transition: transform .1s;
}
.cd-confirm:active { transform: scale(.95); background: #16a34a; }

/* ---------- tastierino numerico grande (come in Creazione UDC) ---------- */
.numpad-host { position: absolute; z-index: 40; background: rgba(15, 23, 42, .95); border: 3px solid #2563eb; }
#screen-carico-ddt .numpad-host:not(.hidden) {
  display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 1.2vh;
  top: 1.5vh; bottom: 1vh; right: 1.2vw; width: 30vw;
  padding: 1.4vh .9vw; border-radius: 1.2rem;
}
#screen-carico-ddt .numpad-host .kp-row { flex: 1 1 0; min-height: 0; width: 100%; gap: .8vw; margin: 0 !important; }
#screen-carico-ddt .numpad-host .vkey { height: auto; align-self: stretch; font-size: clamp(1.4rem, 5.2vh, 3.2rem); border-radius: 10px; }
#screen-carico-ddt .numpad-host .vkey i { font-size: clamp(1.2rem, 4.2vh, 2.6rem); }

/* ---------- proposte formato / pallet ---------- */
.cd-options { position: absolute; z-index: 40; width: 27vw; padding: .5rem; border: 2px solid #3b82f6; border-radius: .75rem; box-shadow: 0 10px 30px rgba(0,0,0,.35); }
.cd-options-list { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: .25rem; }

/* ---------- cronologia bancali ---------- */
.cd-hist { position: absolute; inset: 0; z-index: 30; display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 1vh; padding: 1.5vw; border-radius: 1rem; }
.cd-hist-top { display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: space-between; gap: 1vw; flex-shrink: 0; }
.cd-hist-title { font-weight: 900; letter-spacing: .04em; font-size: clamp(1rem, 2vw, 1.7rem); }
.cd-hist-list { flex: 1 1 0; min-height: 0; overflow-y: auto; overscroll-behavior: contain; display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 1.2vh; scrollbar-width: none; }
.cd-hist-list::-webkit-scrollbar { display: none; }
.cd-hist-empty { text-align: center; padding: 8vh 0; font-weight: 700; font-size: clamp(1rem, 2vw, 1.7rem); }
.cd-hitem {
  display: grid; grid-template-columns: 1.4fr 1.4fr .8fr auto; gap: .5vh 1.2vw; align-items: start;
  width: 100%; flex-shrink: 0; text-align: left; padding: 1.2vh 1.5vw;
  border-width: 2px; border-style: solid; border-radius: .9rem;
}
.cd-hitem > div { min-width: 0; }
.cd-k { display: block; font-size: clamp(.6rem, 1vw, .9rem); font-weight: 600; text-transform: uppercase; opacity: .65; }
.cd-v { display: block; font-size: clamp(.85rem, 1.6vw, 1.5rem); font-weight: 800; overflow-wrap: anywhere; }
.cd-pen { grid-column: 4; grid-row: 1 / 3; align-self: center; font-size: clamp(1rem, 1.8vw, 1.6rem); }

/* ---------- avviso a scomparsa ---------- */
.cd-toast {
  position: absolute; top: 1.2vh; left: 50%; transform: translateX(-50%); z-index: 45;
  padding: .8vh 2vw; border-radius: .8rem; color: #fff; font-weight: 800; text-align: center;
  font-size: clamp(.9rem, 1.7vw, 1.5rem); box-shadow: 0 6px 20px rgba(0,0,0,.35); max-width: 90%;
}
.cd-toast.ok { background: #16a34a; }
.cd-toast.ko { background: #dc2626; }

/* ---------- finestra "chiusura bolla" ---------- */
.cd-modal {
  position: fixed; inset: 0; z-index: 45;
  display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center;
  padding: 2vh 3vw; background: rgba(2, 6, 23, .62);
}
.cd-modal.hidden { display: none !important; }

  <script>
/* ============================================================
 * CORE / APP
 * Nucleo condiviso: registro dei settori, navigazione tra
 * schermate, lingua, tema e piccolo bus di eventi.
 *
 * Ogni settore (js/sectors/*.js) è un oggetto con:
 *   id            nome del settore
 *   html          markup del settore (inserito da App.mount)
 *   i18n          { it:{...}, en:{...}, ... } solo testi del settore
 *   init()        facoltativo, chiamato all'avvio
 *   applyLang(t)  facoltativo, aggiorna i testi quando cambia lingua
 *   onLogin(s)    facoltativo, chiamato dopo il login ({user, site})
 *   onLogout()    facoltativo, chiamato dopo il logout
 *   onTheme(mode) facoltativo, chiamato al cambio tema
 * e si registra con App.register(...).
 * ============================================================ */
(function () {
  const sectors = {};
  const dict = {};      // lingua -> traduzioni di tutti i settori unite
  const handlers = {};  // evento -> [funzioni]

  const App = {
    lang: 'it',
    state: { user: '', site: '' },

    /* ---------- registro settori ---------- */
    register(sector) {
      sectors[sector.id] = sector;

      const i18n = sector.i18n || {};
      Object.keys(i18n).forEach(lang => {
        dict[lang] = dict[lang] || {};
        Object.keys(i18n[lang]).forEach(key => {
          if (key in dict[lang]) {
            console.warn('Traduzione duplicata "' + key + '" (' + lang + ') nel settore ' + sector.id);
          }
          dict[lang][key] = i18n[lang][key];
        });
      });

      if (sector.onLogin)  App.on('login',  s => sector.onLogin(s));
      if (sector.onLogout) App.on('logout', () => sector.onLogout());
      if (sector.onTheme)  App.on('theme',  m => sector.onTheme(m));
      return sector;
    },

    /* Inserisce il markup dei settori nello schermo, nell'ordine indicato. */
    mount(ids) {
      const host = document.querySelector('.terminal-screen');
      ids.forEach(id => {
        const s = sectors[id];
        if (!s) throw new Error('Settore non registrato: ' + id);
        if (s.html) host.insertAdjacentHTML('beforeend', s.html);
      });
    },

    /* Avvio: init di ogni settore, poi lingua iniziale. */
    start(initialLang) {
      Object.keys(sectors).forEach(id => {
        if (sectors[id].init) sectors[id].init();
      });
      App.setLanguage(initialLang || 'it');
    },

    /* ---------- eventi ---------- */
    on(evt, fn) { (handlers[evt] = handlers[evt] || []).push(fn); },
    /* Un errore in un settore non deve bloccare gli altri (né il logout). */
    emit(evt, payload) {
      (handlers[evt] || []).forEach(fn => {
        try { fn(payload); } catch (e) { console.error('Errore nel gestore di "' + evt + '":', e); }
      });
    },

    /* ---------- navigazione ---------- */
    /* Mostra la schermata con l'id indicato e nasconde tutte le altre. */
    show(screenId) {
      document.querySelectorAll('[data-screen]').forEach(el => {
        el.classList.toggle('hidden', el.id !== screenId);
      });
    },

    /* ---------- lingua ---------- */
    t() { return dict[App.lang]; },

    setLanguage(lang) {
      App.lang = lang;
      const t = dict[lang];
      Object.keys(sectors).forEach(id => {
        if (sectors[id].applyLang) sectors[id].applyLang(t, lang);
      });
    },

    /* Applica un dizionario {idElemento: chiaveTraduzione} come testo. */
    applyTexts(t, map) {
      Object.keys(map).forEach(elId => {
        const el = document.getElementById(elId);
        if (el) el.innerText = t[map[elId]];
      });
    },

    /* ---------- tema ---------- */
    setTheme(mode) {
      document.body.classList.toggle('theme-dark', mode === 'dark');
      document.body.classList.toggle('theme-light', mode !== 'dark');
      App.emit('theme', mode);
    }
  };

  window.App = App;
})();

</script>

/* ============================================================
 * CORE / SOUND
 * Suoni dell'interfaccia (tap, login, logout) via Web Audio.
 * ============================================================ */
(function () {
  let ctx = null;

  function getContext() {
    if (!ctx) {
      ctx = new (window.AudioContext || window.webkitAudioContext)();
    }
    if (ctx.state === 'suspended') {
      ctx.resume();
    }
    return ctx;
  }

  /* Suona una sequenza di note: [{freq}], con tipo onda, volume, passo e durata. */
  function playNotes(notes, type, volume, step, length) {
    try {
      const c = getContext();
      notes.forEach((freq, index) => {
        const osc = c.createOscillator();
        const gain = c.createGain();
        osc.type = type;
        osc.frequency.value = freq;

        const startTime = c.currentTime + (index * step);
        gain.gain.setValueAtTime(volume, startTime);
        gain.gain.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(0.001, startTime + length);

        osc.connect(gain);
        gain.connect(c.destination);
        osc.start(startTime);
        osc.stop(startTime + length);
      });
    } catch (e) {
      console.log("Audio non disponibile");
    }
  }

  const Sound = {
    tap() {
      try {
        const c = getContext();
        const osc = c.createOscillator();
        const gain = c.createGain();
        osc.type = 'sine';
        osc.frequency.setValueAtTime(1200, c.currentTime);
        osc.frequency.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(400, c.currentTime + 0.02);

        gain.gain.setValueAtTime(0.05, c.currentTime);
        gain.gain.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(0.001, c.currentTime + 0.02);

        osc.connect(gain);
        gain.connect(c.destination);
        osc.start();
        osc.stop(c.currentTime + 0.02);
      } catch (e) {
        console.log("Audio non disponibile");
      }
    },

    login()  { playNotes([523.25, 659.25, 783.99, 1046.50], 'triangle', 0.08, 0.08, 0.15); },
    logout() { playNotes([783.99, 659.25, 523.25], 'sine', 0.06, 0.07, 0.15); }
  };

  window.Sound = Sound;
})();

/* ============================================================
 * CORE / KEYPAD
 * Tastiera virtuale touch condivisa. Qualsiasi input readonly con
 * data-keypad e onclick="Keypad.open('id', event)" la apre;
 * data-keypad-label="idLabel" indica l'etichetta usata come titolo;
 * data-keypad-mode="abc|num|sym" fa ripartire sempre da quella modalità.
 * Mentre è aperta imposta la classe "keypad-open" sul body

 * ============================================================ */
(function () {
  const html = `
<div id="virtual-keypad" class="hidden absolute bottom-0 left-0 right-0 bg-slate-900/95 backdrop-blur-md border-t-2 border-blue-600 p-2 shadow-2xl z-50 rounded-t-xl">
  <div class="flex items-center justify-between mb-1 px-1">

    <button onclick="Keypad.close()" class="responsive-label bg-red-600 hover:bg-red-700 text-white font-bold px-2 py-0.5 rounded-md">✖</button>
  </div>
  <div class="kp-row" id="keypad-row-1"></div>
  <div class="kp-row" id="keypad-row-2"></div>
  <div class="kp-row" id="keypad-row-3"></div>
  <div class="kp-row" id="keypad-row-4" style="margin-bottom:0"></div>
</div>
`;

  const Keypad = {
    id: 'keypad',
    html,
    activeInputId: null,
    isCaps: true,
    keyMode: 'abc',

    init() {
      /* Un tocco fuori dalla tastiera e fuori dagli input la chiude. */
      document.addEventListener('click', function (event) {
        const keypad = document.getElementById('virtual-keypad');
        if (keypad.classList.contains('hidden')) return;

        const insideKeypad = keypad.contains(event.target);
        const onInput = event.target.closest && event.target.closest('[data-keypad]');
        if (!insideKeypad && !onInput) Keypad.close();
      });
    },

    open(inputId, event) {
      if (event) event.stopPropagation();
      if (window.Numpad) Numpad.close();
      this.activeInputId = inputId;
      document.getElementById('virtual-keypad').classList.remove('hidden');
      document.body.classList.add('keypad-open');

      /* data-keypad-mode="abc|num|sym": riparte sempre da quella modalità */
      const startMode = document.getElementById(inputId).dataset.keypadMode;
      if (startMode) { this.keyMode = startMode; this.isCaps = true; }

      const labelId = document.getElementById(inputId).dataset.keypadLabel;
      const lbl = labelId && document.getElementById(labelId);
      if (lbl) document.getElementById('keypad-title').innerText = lbl.innerText;

      this.render();
      Sound.tap();
    },

    close() {
      document.getElementById('virtual-keypad').classList.add('hidden');
      document.body.classList.remove('keypad-open');
      this.activeInputId = null;
    },

    toggleCaps() {
      this.isCaps = !this.isCaps;
      this.render();
      Sound.tap();
    },

    setMode(mode) {
      this.keyMode = mode;
      this.render();
      Sound.tap();
    },

    input(char) {
      if (!this.activeInputId) return;
      const el = document.getElementById(this.activeInputId);
      Sound.tap();

      const command = typeof char === 'string' ? char.toUpperCase() : char;
      if (command === 'DEL') {
        el.value = el.value.slice(0, -1);
      } else if (command === 'CLR') {
        el.value = '';
      } else if (command === 'SPACE') {
        el.value += ' ';
      } else {
        el.value += char;
      }
      el.dispatchEvent(new Event('input', { bubbles: true }));
    },

    makeKey(label, onPress, cls = '', flex = 1) {
      const k = document.createElement('div');
      k.className = 'vkey ' + cls;
      k.style.flex = flex + ' 1 0';
      k.innerHTML = label;
      k.addEventListener('click', function (e) {
        e.preventDefault();
        e.stopPropagation();
        onPress();
      });
      return k;
    },

    spacer(flex = 0.5) {
      const d = document.createElement('div');
      d.className = 'vkey-spacer';
      d.style.flex = flex + ' 1 0';
      return d;
    },

    render() {
      const self = Keypad;
      const rows = [1, 2, 3, 4].map(n => document.getElementById('keypad-row-' + n));
      rows.forEach(r => { r.innerHTML = ''; });
      const [r1, r2, r3, r4] = rows;
      const chars = (arr, row) => arr.forEach(c => row.appendChild(self.makeKey(c === '&' ? '&' : c === '<' ? '<' : c === '>' ? '>' : c, () => self.input(c))));
      const delKey = () => self.makeKey('<i class="fa-solid fa-delete-left"></i>', () => self.input('DEL'), 'del', 1.5);

      if (self.keyMode === 'abc') {
        const L1 = ['Q','W','E','R','T','Y','U','I','O','P'];
        const L2 = ['A','S','D','F','G','H','J','K','L'];
        const L3 = ['Z','X','C','V','B','N','M'];
        const cs = k => self.isCaps ? k : k.toLowerCase();

        chars(L1.map(cs), r1);

        r2.appendChild(self.spacer());
        chars(L2.map(cs), r2);
        r2.appendChild(self.spacer());

        r3.appendChild(self.makeKey('<i class="fa-solid fa-arrow-up"></i>', () => self.toggleCaps(), self.isCaps ? 'on' : 'fn', 1.5));
        chars(L3.map(cs), r3);
        r3.appendChild(delKey());
      } else if (self.keyMode === 'num') {
        chars(['1','2','3','4','5','6','7','8','9','0'], r1);
        chars(['-','/',':',';','(',')','€','&','@','"'], r2);
        r3.appendChild(self.makeKey('#+=', () => self.setMode('sym'), 'fn', 1.5));
        chars(['.',',','?','!',"'",'_','+'], r3);
        r3.appendChild(delKey());
      } else {
        chars(['[',']','{','}','#','%','^','*','+','='], r1);
        chars(['\\','|','~','<','>','$','£','¥','•','`'], r2);
        r3.appendChild(self.makeKey('123', () => self.setMode('num'), 'fn', 1.5));
        chars(['.',',','?','!',"'",'"','-'], r3);
        r3.appendChild(delKey());
      }

      r4.appendChild(self.makeKey(self.keyMode === 'abc' ? '123' : 'ABC', () => self.setMode(self.keyMode === 'abc' ? 'num' : 'abc'), 'fn', 1.5));
      r4.appendChild(self.makeKey('', () => self.input('SPACE'), '', 5));
      r4.appendChild(self.makeKey('CANC', () => self.input('CLR'), 'clr', 1.5));
      r4.appendChild(self.makeKey('OK', () => self.close(), 'ok', 1.5));
    }
  };

  window.Keypad = App.register(Keypad);
})();

 * Tastierino numerico compatto, pensato per stare di lato senza
 * coprire i campi. Si usa così:
 *   - nella schermata un contenitore vuoto  <div id="numpad" class="hidden absolute ..."></div>

 * Dopo ogni modifica lancia l'evento "input" sul campo.
 * ============================================================ */
(function () {
  const Numpad = {
    id: 'numpad',
    activeInputId: null,

    /* Il contenitore del tastierino della schermata visibile (classe "numpad-host");
       in mancanza, quello con id="numpad" (Creazione UDC). */
    host() {
      return document.querySelector('[data-screen]:not(.hidden) .numpad-host') || document.getElementById('numpad');
    },

    init() {
      document.addEventListener('click', function (event) {
        const host = Numpad.host();
        if (!host || host.classList.contains('hidden')) return;
        const t = event.target;
        if (host.contains(t) || (t.closest && t.closest('[data-numpad]'))) return;
        Numpad.close();
      });
    },

    open(inputId, event) {
      const host = Numpad.host();
      if (!host) return;
      Keypad.close();
      Numpad.clearActive();
      Numpad.activeInputId = inputId;
      document.getElementById(inputId).classList.add('ring-2', 'ring-blue-600');
      host.classList.remove('hidden');
      Numpad.render();
      Sound.tap();
    },

    clearActive() {
      if (Numpad.activeInputId) {
        const el = document.getElementById(Numpad.activeInputId);
        if (el) el.classList.remove('ring-2', 'ring-blue-600');
      }
    },

    close() {
      const host = Numpad.host();
      Numpad.clearActive();
      Numpad.activeInputId = null;
      if (host) host.classList.add('hidden');
    },

    input(char) {
      if (!Numpad.activeInputId) return;
      const el = document.getElementById(Numpad.activeInputId);
      Sound.tap();
      const command = typeof char === 'string' ? char.toUpperCase() : char;
      if (command === 'DEL') el.value = el.value.slice(0, -1);
      else if (command === 'CLR') el.value = '';
      else el.value += char;
      el.dispatchEvent(new Event('input', { bubbles: true }));
    },

    key(label, onPress, cls = '', flex = 1) {
      const k = document.createElement('div');
      k.className = 'vkey ' + cls;
      k.style.flex = flex + ' 1 0';
      k.innerHTML = label;
      k.addEventListener('click', function (e) {
        e.preventDefault();
        e.stopPropagation();
        onPress();
      });
      return k;
    },

    render() {
      const host = Numpad.host();
      const el = document.getElementById(Numpad.activeInputId);
      const allowX = el && el.hasAttribute('data-numpad-x');
      host.innerHTML = '';

      const row = (build) => {
        const r = document.createElement('div');
        r.className = 'kp-row';
        build(r);
        host.appendChild(r);
        return r;
      };
      const digits = (arr) => (r) => arr.forEach(d => r.appendChild(Numpad.key(d, () => Numpad.input(d))));

      row(digits(['7', '8', '9']));
      row(digits(['4', '5', '6']));
      row(digits(['1', '2', '3']));
      const last = row(r => {
        if (allowX) r.appendChild(Numpad.key('x', () => Numpad.input('x'), 'fn'));
        else { const s = document.createElement('div'); s.className = 'vkey-spacer'; s.style.flex = '1 1 0'; r.appendChild(s); }
        r.appendChild(Numpad.key('0', () => Numpad.input('0')));
        r.appendChild(Numpad.key('<i class="fa-solid fa-delete-left"></i>', () => Numpad.input('DEL'), 'del'));
      });
      last.style.marginBottom = '4px';
      row(r => {
        r.appendChild(Numpad.key('CANC', () => Numpad.input('CLR'), 'clr', 1));
        r.appendChild(Numpad.key('OK', () => Numpad.close(), 'ok', 1));
      }).style.marginBottom = '0';
    }
  };

  window.Numpad = App.register(Numpad);
})();

      if (!configured) { Update.hide(); return; }

      try {
        Update.message(t.updChecking, 15);
        const ctrl = new AbortController();
        const timer = setTimeout(() => ctrl.abort(), 8000);
        /* bundle.json (l'app intera) nel repository pubblico -updates. "?t=" evita le cache. */
        const res = await fetch('https://api.github.com/repos/' + UPDATES_REPO + '/contents/bundle.json?t=' + Date.now(), {
          signal: ctrl.signal,
          headers: { 'Accept': 'application/vnd.github.raw+json' },
          cache: 'no-store'
        });
        if (!res.ok) { clearTimeout(timer); throw new Error('HTTP ' + res.status); }
        Update.message(t.updDownloading, 45);
        const text = await res.text();
        clearTimeout(timer);

        const bundle = JSON.parse(text);
        if (!bundle || !bundle.version || !bundle.html) throw new Error('bundle non valido');

        /* una versione che non è riuscita ad avviarsi non viene riscaricata */
        let bad = null;
        try { bad = localStorage.getItem('mz_bad'); } catch (e) {}

        if (!isNewer(bundle.version, APP_VERSION) || (bad && !isNewer(bundle.version, bad))) {
          /* mostra versione installata / ultima disponibile */
          Update.message(t.updUpToDate + ' (' + APP_VERSION + ' / ' + bundle.version + ')', 100);
          setTimeout(Update.hide, 2500);
          return;
        }

        Update.message(t.updInstalling + ' ' + bundle.version, 90);
        localStorage.setItem('mz_bundle', text);
        localStorage.removeItem('mz_try');
        localStorage.removeItem('mz_bad');
        Update.message(t.updInstalling + ' ' + bundle.version, 100);
        setTimeout(() => location.reload(), 400);
      } catch (e) {
        console.log('Controllo aggiornamenti non riuscito:', e);
        /* l'errore resta visibile qualche secondo, poi si prosegue con il login */
        const why = (e && (e.message || e.error || e.code)) || (typeof e === 'string' ? e : JSON.stringify(e));
        Update.message(t.updFailed + ': ' + why + ' [v' + APP_VERSION + ']', 100);
        setTimeout(Update.hide, 7000);
      }
    }
  };

  window.Update = App.register(Update);
})();

    },

    applyLang(t) {

      this.updateEditBar();

    onLogout() {
      Object.keys(STATO).forEach(k => delete STATO[k]);
      this.closeAll();
      this.ordine = null; this.stato = null;
    },

    open(ordine) {
      Sound.tap();
      this.closeAll();
      this.ordine = ordine;
      if (!STATO[ordine.numero]) {
        const base = ARTICOLI_DDT[ordine.numero] || ARTICOLI_DEFAULT;
        const palletsIniziali = (BANCALI_INIZIALI_DDT[ordine.numero] ? JSON.parse(JSON.stringify(BANCALI_INIZIALI_DDT[ordine.numero])) : []);
        STATO[ordine.numero] = {
          righe: base.map(r => ({ articolo: r.articolo, formato: r.formato, totale: r.totale, base: 0 })),
          pallets: palletsIniziali
        };
      }
      this.stato = STATO[ordine.numero];
      $('cd-h-ordine').innerText = ordine.numero;
      $('cd-h-targa').innerText = ordine.targa;
      $('cd-h-forn').innerText = ordine.fornitore;

      this.updateCount();
      App.show('screen-carico-ddt');

    back() {
      this.closeAll();
      Sound.tap();
      if (window.UdcDdt && typeof UdcDdt.open === 'function') {
        UdcDdt.open();
      }

    closeInputs() {
      Keypad.close();
      Numpad.close();
      this.closeOptions();

    closeAll() {
      this.closeInputs();
      $('cd-history').classList.add('hidden');
      $('btn-cd-history').classList.remove('on');
      $('cd-close-modal').classList.add('hidden');

    rigaDi(art) { return this.stato && this.stato.righe.find(r => r.articolo === art); },

        .filter(p => p.articolo === r.articolo && p.id !== escludiId)
        .reduce((s, p) => s + p.quantita, 0);
    },

    rimasti(r, escludiId) { return r.totale - this.caricato(r, escludiId); },

    maxQty(art) {
      const r = this.rigaDi(art);
      if (!r || !BLOCCA_OLTRE_DDT) return MAX_PIASTRELLE;
      return Math.max(0, Math.min(MAX_PIASTRELLE, this.rimasti(r, this.editing)));
    },

    openNum(id, event) {
      if (id === 'cd-barcode' && this.editing !== null) { if (event) event.stopPropagation(); return; }

    isArticoloValido(v) { return RE_ARTICOLO.test(v) && !!this.rigaDi(v); },

      this.sel = r ? r.articolo : null;
      if (r) $('cd-formato').value = r.formato;
      this.renderTable();
    },

    refresh() {
      $('cd-art-status').innerHTML = this.isArticoloValido($('cd-articolo').value) ? ICON_OK : ICON_KO;
    },

    read() {
      return {
        barcode: $('cd-barcode').value.trim(),
        articolo: $('cd-articolo').value.trim(),
        quantita: parseInt($('cd-qty').value, 10),
        formato: $('cd-formato').value.trim(),
        pallet: $('cd-pallet').value.trim()
      };
    },

    errors(d) {
      const bad = [];
      let msg = null;
      if (!d.barcode) bad.push('cd-barcode');
      else if (this.stato.pallets.some(p => p.barcode === d.barcode && p.id !== this.editing)) { bad.push('cd-barcode'); msg = 'cdDup'; }
      if (!this.isArticoloValido(d.articolo)) bad.push('cd-articolo');
      const max = this.maxQty(d.articolo);
      if (!(d.quantita >= 1 && d.quantita <= max)) {
        bad.push('cd-qty');
        if (this.isArticoloValido(d.articolo) && d.quantita > 0 && d.quantita <= MAX_PIASTRELLE) msg = msg || 'cdOverDdt';
      }
      if (!d.formato) bad.push('cd-formato');
      if (!d.pallet) bad.push('cd-pallet');
      return { bad, msg };

      $('cd-qty').dispatchEvent(new Event('input', { bubbles: true }));

        Sound.tap();

        return;

      let rec, modo;
      if (this.editing !== null) {
        rec = this.stato.pallets.find(p => p.id === this.editing);
        Object.assign(rec, { articolo: d.articolo, quantita: d.quantita, formato: d.formato, pallet: d.pallet });

  ];

  App.mount(MOUNT);

  window.onload = function () {
    App.start('it');
    /* avvio arrivato in fondo: l'eventuale aggiornamento scaricato è sano */
    try { localStorage.removeItem('mz_try'); } catch (e) {}
    Update.check();
    setTimeout(Update.hide, 40000);
  };
})();
